author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
If AI can't read it, it doesn't exist

Just like in web 2.0 era, if Google can't index your website, it doesn't exist.
In the AI era, you have to make everything AI readable.

author.name: Jarmo Venalainen
author.headline: Studying what AI is, what it can do and what it will do.

comments.text:
Yes.  Do this.

1.	Let the robot visit
If the robot isn’t allowed on your page, it doesn’t exist to it.

2.	Put the words on the page
The robot needs to see the words right away, not hidden behind buttons.

3.	Say what it’s about clearly
Use simple words and a clear title, like a school poster.

4.	Tell the robot what things are
Add labels like “this is a person” or “this is an article” so it understands.

5.	Use a clean web address
Short, clear links are easier for robots to remember.

6.	Make it easy to copy
Short paragraphs and headings help the robot grab the right part.

7.	Keep it fast and neat
Slow or messy pages are hard to read.

8.	Give it a map
A sitemap is a list of all your pages so the robot doesn’t miss any.
